summary: GFL Environmental Inc. filed a Form 6-K on June 22, 2026, announcing a proposed private offering of $750 million aggregate principal amount of senior notes due 2031. The notes will be issued by a U.S. wholly owned subsidiary and guaranteed by GFL and certain subsidiaries. Proceeds will repay revolving credit facility drawings to free liquidity for the previously announced acquisition of SECURE Waste Infrastructure Corp. and for other growth initiatives. The offering is not registered under the Securities Act; targeting QIBs under Rule 144A and offshore under Regulation S. This is a routine debt capital markets transaction, not a special situation.
